'''Bulo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] he was attacked in [[Coratanni Town]] by a group hired by the former Ravagers [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ruugar]]. Bulo put up a fight, but was eventually overwhelmed and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quartermaster Bulo appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
